shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -80 && rg -n \"(Avatar|FileUpload|Toggle|Checkbox|Select|TextInput|Button)\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit --glob '*.d.ts' | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- Checkbox ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- Toggle ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toggle/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- Avatar ---\\n'; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- Button ---\\n'; rg -n \"export declare|type ButtonProps|interface ButtonProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Toggle\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toggle -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*.d.ts' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toggle/*.d.ts | head -180 && printf '\\n--- Checkbox types ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -160; printf '\\n--- Avatar props ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts; printf '\\n--- Button props ---\\n'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts && printf '\\n--- search controls ---\\n'; rg -n \"type SwitchProps|export declare const (Switch|Toggle)|Switch|Toggle\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components --glob '*.d.ts' | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; printf '\\n--- layout exports ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout -name '*.d.ts' -maxdepth 2 -print | xargs -r sed -n '1,120p'; printf '\\n--- control props ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts; printf '\\n--- Flex ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; printf '\\n--- TextInput ---\\n'; rg -n \"interface TextInputProps|type TextInputProps|export declare const TextInput\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput -g '*.d.ts'; rg -n \"size\\?|placeholder|value|onUpdate|error\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/common/types.d.ts | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"TextInput\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -60 && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,30p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts; git diff --stat 2>/dev/null || true; git status --short 2>/dev/null || true; wc -l src/App.tsx src/App.css; rg -n \"Настройки профиля|Загрузить аватар|Сохранить|Отмена\" src/App.tsx"
